items.Sentence: The headworks include a rotary hydroscreen system
The cleaned and dewatered solids are disposed of at a landfill.

The treatment system consists of ... an aeration pond (also known as the South Pond) ... the first cell contains two 7.5-horsepower aerators ... the third cell contains a 3-horsepower aerator, set on a timer, to create aerobic and anoxic conditions within the pond.

The settling pond (also known as the North Pond) is used for storage ... Wastewater from the settling pond is recirculated to the aeration pond ... biosolids generated during the treatment process accumulate in the aeration and settling ponds, where they undergo anaerobic digestion
Tertiary treatment is achieved in the microfiltration system ... The microfiltration system consists of two treatment trains ...
From the microfiltration system, filtered wastewater flows to the chlorine contact tank ... chlorinated effluent ... the chlorinated effluent is dechlorinated using sodium bisulfite.
Sodium hypochlorite is stored in a 540-gallon tank
Sodium hypochlorite ... is conveyed to the injection point through a 1-inch line by a pair of peristaltic pumps.
Treated wastewater is discharged to an approximately 3.25-million-gallon effluent storage pond used for storage of advanced treated wastewater
approximately 99 dry tons of solids were removed from the ponds and land applied by Synagro Technologies, Inc.
A chlorine gas system was replaced with a sodium hypochlorite system in May 2014.
